chunks: From him, from his father, from Abu Al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, says: 'My believing servant grieves if I restrict him, and that is closer to Me; and My believing servant rejoices if I expand for him, and that is more remote from Me.'

key_terms.قَتَّرَ: To restrict or constrain, referring to hardship or limited provision
key_terms.وَسَّعَ: To expand or broaden, referring to ease or abundant provision

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of grief versus joy in relation to divine decree?
ai.summary: This Hadith Qudsi from al-Kafi elucidates the dialectic of divine testing, where restriction (qatrah) induces grief that fosters spiritual proximity, while ease (was'ah) elicits joy that may lead to heedlessness. In Shia scholarship, this underscores the virtue of patience (sabr) during hardship as a means of drawing nearer to Allah, contrasting with the potential spiritual danger of complacency in prosperity. It reflects the concept that divine wisdom often prioritizes the soul's ultimate closeness to God over immediate worldly comfort.

en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Abu Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “My<sup>azwj</sup> believing servant grieves when I<sup>saww</sup> drip a drop upon him, and that makes him closer to Me<sup>azwj</sup>; and My<sup>azwj</sup> believing servant is happy when I<sup>azwj</sup> Expand upon him, and that makes him remote from Me<sup>azwj</sup>”’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from abu al-Bakhtari from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has said, ‘I find My believing servant depressed if I provide his sustenance in stringent measures; a condition that is closer to Me but 1 find My believing servant happier when I provide his sustenance plentifully; however, such condition is further away from Me.’”
